name: Connecticut Interstate Depositions and Discovery Act

sections.heading: Sec. 52-660. Uniformity of application and construction.

body: In applying and construing the provisions of sections 52-655 to 52-659, inclusive, consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among the states that enact such uniform provisions.
history: History: P.A. 22-26 effective July 1, 2023, and applicable to any request for discovery in an action pending on or filed on or after said date; P.A. 23-38 replaced reference to Sec. 52-660 with reference to Sec. 52-659.
content.plainText: In applying and construing the provisions of sections 52-655 to 52-659, inclusive, consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among the states that enact such uniform provisions.
